summary: Retest of iteration_37 (auto-translation). BACKEND: 24/24 pytest pass, using v1_18 plus the new v1_19 file. The 24 English service names/descs → zh came back fully in Chinese in 3 of 3 fresh attempts (zh cache cleared, 5-6s each) with failed=[]. 'ناقل إكسبرس' → 'Naqel Express' in de/fr/zh/en/ja. 48 texts → de in parallel chunks took 12s. The 'failed' list is returned. FRONTEND (375x667, customer): no wrong-language DB text after the wait on Home banner, Competitions tab, Support hours, About-store pills/map, Loyalty history, Product colour/specs or Notifications in en/de/zh/he. English-only content becomes Arabic in ar. One field remains: the competition DETAIL prize is still raw <Text>. Device cache key is @zenrex_dyn_tr_v3. Results equal to the source are not cached. Translatable now has its own key. The notification chip is now compact (24x21), but the product-name chip is still full width (329px). Regression: merchant/chamber/driver/customer in ar/en/de/zh/he show no page errors and no red screen. A first load in a new language can take 12-20s (he Competitions was still Arabic at 12s and translated at 20s).

minor.issue: The all-cached early return has no 'failed' key, so the response shape is inconsistent. translate.py:254-255
Still not fixed from iter 37: if the retry is unclean, the bad translation is returned uncached, so the LLM is called again on every request. translate.py:225-226

integration_issues.issue: comp.prize is raw <Text>. 'سيارة تسلا Model 3 + iPhone 15 Pro' stays Arabic in en/de/zh/he, and 'Win 1 of 5 iPhone 15s' stays English in ar. app/competition/[id].tsx:101

needsTranslation('ar') returns false whenever the text has any Arabic, so mixed AR+EN text is never unified in ar. Example notification body: 'طلب #e87b8bce - الحالة: delivered'. src/components/TranslatableName.tsx:122. This could also be fixed at the source by localising the status in the backend notification text.

Arabic user names stay Arabic in en/de/zh/he: merchant dashboard recent orders ('عبدالله القحطاني • 1 item'), chamber lists, driver welcome 'محمد السائق' (app/driver/index.tsx:82; seed server.py:3538 contains the word 'السائق' = 'the driver'), competition participants/winners (competition/[id].tsx:121,138,193). Decide whether to transliterate.

issues: The 'Original' chip under the product name is still 329x21 (full width). Translatable non-inline wrapper `<View style={{ marginTop: 2 }}>` has no alignSelf:'flex-start', and Translatable's iconBtn style is also missing alignSelf. src/components/Translatable.tsx:264,275 (used at app/product/[id].tsx:86).

The chip is now compact (24x21), but with inline={false} it sits on its own line under every title and body (4 chips for 2 notifications). Also, a wrapped description pushes its chip onto a separate line above the prize pill. Chip is 21px tall (41 with hitSlop), under 44.

action_items: Wrap comp.prize with TranslatableName in app/competition/[id].tsx:101.
Translatable.tsx:264 → add alignSelf:'flex-start' (as in TranslatableName.tsx:312) and add alignSelf to styles.iconBtn, so the product-name chip is not full width.
needsTranslation('ar'): also return true when Arabic text contains real non-brand Latin words (e.g. 'delivered'), or localise the order status in the backend notification body.
Optional: show the notification/competition chips inline (or iconOnly next to the title) to reduce clutter. Decide on person-name transliteration.
Minor: add 'failed': [] to the bulk all-cached response. Cache or mark the unclean single-translate result.
critical_code_review_comments: Translatable.tsx still duplicates about 60 lines of the fetch/cache/toast logic from TranslatableName.tsx (separate key @zenrex_dyn_tr_multi_v3 now, so it no longer overwrites the shared cache, but DRY remains).
flush() still has no fetch timeout/AbortController. A hung bulk call leaves queued texts pending forever.

success_rate.frontend: ~90% (all iter-37 fields fixed except the competition-detail prize; product chip still full width; no crashes on 4 roles x 5 langs)
